title: Three-axis Inertial Measurement Unit
text: 实现三轴惯性测量单元 (IMU)，输入 5 路、输出 2 路；{Units} 指定单位 Metric、{IMU location} 指定 IMU 位置、{Update rate} 指定更新速率、{Second order dynamics for accelerometer} 指定二阶动态、{Accelerometer natural frequency (rad/sec)} 指定加速度计固有频率、{Accelerometer damping ratio} 指定加速度计阻尼比、{Accelerometer scale factor and cross-coupling} 指定比例因子与交叉耦合、{Accelerometer measurement bias} 指定加速度计测量偏置、{Accelerometer upper and lower limits} 指定加速度的最小值和最大值、{Second-order dynamics for gyro} 指定陀螺仪二阶动态特性、{Gyro natural frequency (rad/sec)} 指定陀螺仪固有频率、{Gyro damping ratio} 指定陀螺仪阻尼比、{Gyro scale factors and cross-coupling} 指定陀螺仪比例因子和交叉耦合、{Gyro measurement bias} 指定陀螺仪测量偏置、{G-sensitive bias} 指定速率最大变化、{Gyro upper and lower limits} 指定角速率的最小值和最大值、{Noise on} 指定白噪声、{Noise seeds} 指定噪声种子、{Noise power} 指定噪声功率，按实例取值。

params.name: Update rate
params.values: 更新速率 0 (default) | real, double scalar

params.name: Accelerometer natural frequency (rad/sec)
params.values: 加速度计固有频率 190 (default) | real, double scalar

params.name: Accelerometer damping ratio
params.values: 加速度计阻尼比 0.707 (default) | real, double scalar

params.name: Accelerometer scale factor and cross-coupling
params.values: 比例因子与交叉耦合 [1 0 0; 0 1 0; 0 0 1] (default) | 3-by-3 matrix

params.name: Accelerometer measurement bias
params.values: 加速度计测量偏置 [0 0 0] (default) | three-element vector

params.name: Accelerometer upper and lower limits
params.values: 加速度的最小值和最大值 [-inf -inf -inf inf inf inf] (default) | six-element vector

params.name: Second-order dynamics for gyro
params.values: 陀螺仪二阶动态特性 on (default) | off

params.name: Gyro natural frequency (rad/sec)
params.values: 陀螺仪固有频率 190 (default) | real, double scalar

params.name: Gyro damping ratio
params.values: 陀螺仪阻尼比 0.707 (default) | real, double scalar

params.name: Gyro scale factors and cross-coupling
params.values: 陀螺仪比例因子和交叉耦合 [1 0 0; 0 1 0; 0 0 1] (default) | 3-by-3 matrix

params.name: Gyro measurement bias
params.values: 陀螺仪测量偏置 [0 0 0] (default) | three-element vector

params.name: G-sensitive bias
params.values: 速率最大变化 [0 0 0] (default) | three-element vector

params.name: Gyro upper and lower limits
params.values: 角速率的最小值和最大值 [-inf -inf -inf inf inf inf] (default) | six-element vector
